patch_description:
Reduce parameter count and improve inductive bias by:
- Sharing all center-edge CRZ couplings under a single "crz_center" parameter (was split NS/EW).
- Merging the four CCRZ centre/corner/edge controls into two symmetry groups: "ccrz_center" (edge-edge-center) and "ccrz_diag" (corner-corner-center).
- Replace the final per-wire RZ-only phase layer with compact two-step rotations RZ->RX that share a single "rot_*" parameter per symmetry group (corners/edges/center). This ties phase+axis rotation into a single learned angle, reducing redundant degrees of freedom while increasing expressive single-qubit local rotations.
These changes reduce N_PARAMS_PER_BLOCK from 16 to 13 (N_PARAMS from 96 to 78), matching a previously successful compact motif architecture. Fewer parameters should improve parameter efficiency and help generalization while preserving geometric/line motifs (ZZZ/CCRZ) important for tic-tac-toe structure.
